mechanism: WebPage's onProgressChange handler writes a hilog log line for every progress event. Web progress fires dozens of times per page load (per sub-resource), so opening any article emits a log storm on the UI thread (formatting + hilog IPC per event), adding overhead to every page load.
fix_summary: Progress is logged only at milestones (every 25% and completion), cutting per-event formatting and hilog traffic during page loads.

performance_oracle.definition: raw-instruction-retired sample count attributed to the app process during the measured step, aggregated from perf.data (HapRay perf.db instruction counts).
performance_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant
